title: Sheaf Tor bounds pass to termwise principal localization
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $P$ be any cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let $U$ be an open subscheme of $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme]. Choose derived categories for $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, $U$, and $\operatorname{Spec}(A_f)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $a,b$ be integers. Suppose the derived restriction $E_U$ to $U$ of the termwise associated-sheaf complex of $P$ satisfies $H^i(E_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}G)=0$ for every module sheaf $G$ on $U$ and every $i<a$ or $b<i$, as expressed by [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. For every $f\in A$ with $D(f)\subseteq U$, let $P_f$ be the termwise localization defined by Mathlib's ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor at the powers of $f$. Then $H^i(\widetilde{P_f}\otimes^{\mathbf L}H)=0$ for every module sheaf $H$ on $\operatorname{Spec}(A_f)$ and every $i<a$ or $b<i$, in the same vanishing predicate. No boundedness, freeness, quasi-compactness, or ordering condition on $a,b$ is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 20.48.4, statement and proof (open-immersion specialization), combined with Tag 08DW(2), affine derived pullback

proof.text: For j:D(f) -> U, test the bound on U against the ordinary direct image j_*H of an arbitrary module sheaf H on D(f). The open-immersion restriction counit identifies its restriction with H. Exact restriction commutes with cohomology and with derived tensor by the open-restriction tensor comparison, so the same interval bounds the restriction of E_U tensored with every H. The ordinary direct image need not be exact: it is only used to provide a sheaf to test. This is the open-immersion case of Tag 09U8.

Identify D(f) with Spec(A_f). The composite restriction of tilde(P) is derived pullback along A -> A_f. The affine derived-pullback comparison identifies it with tilde of derived localization of P. Localization is exact on modules, so the termwise localization Q preserves quasi-isomorphisms and represents derived localization for arbitrary P. The canonical Shrink equivalences in ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor commute with its maps and hence with every differential. Transport across the affine scheme isomorphism and these complex isomorphisms identifies the cohomology vanishing with the stated predicate for Q(tilde(Q)).

proof_origin.place: Open-immersion case; explicit direct-image testing argument as in the parent node, with Tag 08DW(2) affine localization computation

theorem principal_localization_sheaf_tor_bounds
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wU}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace),
      ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
        schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes U.toScheme
          ((@Functor.mapDerivedCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
                (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
              Equivalence.functor
                (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
                  ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))
                (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
                (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U))
            (Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _)
            (comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _) (comp_preservesFiniteColimits _ _)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
                (tilde.functor (.of A)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))) G i)
    (f : A) (hf : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wF}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace))] :
    ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u}
        (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace),
      ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
        schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))
              (SheafOfModules.{u}
                (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
              (tilde.functor (.of (Localization.Away f))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
              (((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor (Submonoid.powers f)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P))) G i
